description: Configure the existing Freestyle job named 'legacy-system-build' to use a custom workspace. Navigate to the job configuration, find the 'Advanced' project options (under General), and set the 'Use custom workspace' Directory to '/tmp/legacy_ws'. Save the configuration and trigger a build ('Build Now') to verify the workspace is created and used. You are already logged in as admin. If prompted, use Username: admin, Password: Admin123!
